shared_elements: low-relief human figures in strict profile
bearded/coiffed figures with patterned hair and headgear
figures holding objects in outstretched hands
rosette / floral motif used as a decorative border band
frieze bordered by a band of repeated ornament
garments rendered with fine parallel incised lines and fringes
procession/striding pose with one leg advanced
justification: Both are shallow relief friezes of profile human figures with elaborately patterned hair/beard, fringed and finely-striated garments, arms extended holding objects, framed by a border band of repeated rosette/floral ornament — a fairly specific shared convention rather than a generic one. The biggest difference in content is that A shows a mundane procession of attendants leading a two-humped camel, while B shows a single large winged supernatural figure with a bucket-like vessel beside a stylised plant, with no animals and no procession.
